description: Low and high values for one-at-a-time and factorial scenarios. A range marked 'sourced' is quoted in a cited paper; 'author-selected' ranges are chosen for this analysis (x0.5 to x2 or +-50% unless stated) and are scenario values, not uncertainty intervals.

firing_rate.source: Barrel cortex mean rates during sleep (3.8 Hz) and active running (7.8 Hz): Vijayan et al. 2010, doi:10.1152/jn.00474.2009, as cited by Howarth et al. 2012

na_overlap_factor.source: 1.24 measured in cortical pyramidal neurons (Carter and Bean 2009, doi:10.1016/j.neuron.2009.12.011); 4 from squid axon (Hodgkin 1975, doi:10.1098/rstb.1975.0010), used by Attwell and Laughlin 2001

release_probability.source: x0.5 to x2 of the reference 0.25

glutamate_per_vesicle.source: x0.5 to x2 of the reference

presynaptic_vesicle_cost_multiplier.source: counted once (1) versus the spreadsheet's twice (2)
